fields.name: IDataProviderServiceFactory provider execution family
fields.contract: IDataProviderServiceFactory is the provider-neutral execution boundary for a Query contract. An implementation shall: classify a supplied Exception as transient or non-transient; create a provider DbConnection from a supplied connection string; create a provider DbCommand carrying supplied command text and associated with a supplied provider connection; and populate a supplied DbCommand from a DbParameterCollection, optionally selecting parameters by a supplied name list and accepting a supplied name-to-value map. The concrete connection, command, parameter, and transient-error rules are provider-specific while callers consume DbConnection, DbCommand, and DbParameterCollection base types.
